subject: Request for onboarding/offboarding evidence for SOC 2 / SIG mapping
messages:
From: Lindsey Harrow <lindsey.harrow@acme.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Evidence request: onboarding, background checks, offboarding controls (SOC 2 / SIG)

Hi Karthik,

We're preparing for Acme FinTech's vendor risk review next week and our security team asked for evidence around your employee lifecycle controls to map to SOC 2 CC6 and SIG/CAIQ items. Specifically they requested:

- Proof of identity/background checks for new hires (vendor reports or policy describing scope).
- Records of mandatory security training completion for the last 12 months and training curriculum.
- Offboarding checklist and evidence that access removal is timely (examples for recent departures).
- Any SOC 2 control narratives or artifacts referencing onboarding/offboarding.

Would it be possible to send a single evidence package (PDFs or Drive links) by EOD Nov 6? If you need to share via a secure portal, we can accept DocuSign or a temporary Drive link.

Thanks,

Lindsey Harrow
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager
Acme FinTech
lindsey.harrow@acme.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Lindsey Harrow <lindsey.harrow@acme.com>
Date: 2025-11-02T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Evidence request: onboarding, background checks, offboarding controls (SOC 2 / SIG)

Folks — forwarding Acme's ask. Can security + HR pull together an evidence pack (policy docs, training logs, examples of offboarding timelines) and confirm anything that needs legal review before we send? Lindsey has asked for delivery by EOD Nov 6.

I expect:
- Background check policy + vendor report samples (HR)
- Training curriculum + completion logs (Security/People ops)
- Offboarding playbook + 2 redacted examples (Security/IT)
- SOC 2 control narrative snippets (Compliance)

Please reply with attachments or Drive links and flag any PII concerns. Marcus, can you own the consolidation? Mina, can HR export the background-check summary CSV?

Thanks — Karthik

> - Any SOC 2 control narratives or artifacts referencing onboarding/offboarding.

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Lindsey Harrow <lindsey.harrow@acme.com>
Date: 2025-11-03T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evidence request: onboarding, background checks, offboarding controls (SOC 2 / SIG)

Karthik / team — I can take point on consolidation. Quick status and plan: 

1) Background checks
- We maintain a background-check policy (attached: background_check_policy.pdf) and vendor reports are generated per-hire. We cannot attach raw PII results; instead we'll provide redacted vendor sample reports and a vendor attestation (redacted) confirming scope. HR will provide a summary CSV with hire dates and check completed flags.

2) Training
- Attached: security-training-completion-logs.csv (export from LMS), and a short training curriculum PDF. Training is mandatory on hire and annually; curriculum map included in the Drive link.

3) Offboarding
- Attached: redwood_offboarding_playbook_v2.pdf (internal playbook). We'll include two redacted examples showing timestamps for account deprovisioning.

4) SOC 2 artifacts
- SOC2_AICPA_cert.pdf included; control narrative snippets (CC6, CC7) live in the folder.

I will upload the package to a temporary Drive folder and share the link. Note: the background vendor requires a DPA addendum for direct vendor report sharing — legal to confirm whether we can share vendor-supplied reports directly or provide attestation only.

Attachments: background_check_policy.pdf; redwood_offboarding_playbook_v2.pdf; security-training-completion-logs.csv; SOC2_AICPA_cert.pdf

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleDriveLink

Marcus Lin
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Lindsey Harrow <lindsey.harrow@acme.com>
Date: 2025-11-04T10:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evidence request: onboarding, background checks, offboarding controls (SOC 2 / SIG)

Thanks — quick HR notes: 
- Background checks are done through ClearCheck (vendor). We perform ID verification + national criminal check for US hires and identity verification for international hires; policy attached.
- I've exported the high-level summary (security-training-completion-logs.csv) and background-check summary (redacted) into the Drive folder Marcus shared. The CSV includes hire date, role, check_completed=true/false, and redaction token (we do not include SSNs or DOBs).

I've also attached onboarding_checklist.xlsx which shows the standard steps (IT account creation, access provisioning, training enrollment) and timestamps we capture in the HRIS. For offboarding examples we'll redact employee names and provide timestamps showing access removal within 24 hours for the two most recent departures (Oct 12 and Oct 28).

Attachments uploaded to Drive. Let me know if Acme needs the vendor attestation rather than sampled reports — legal/PRIV will advise.

Mina Haddad
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lindsey Harrow <lindsey.harrow@acme.com>, Acme Compliance Portal <compliance@acme.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, Oliver Stone <oliver.stone@thirdparty-audit.com>
Date: 2025-11-06T15:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence package: onboarding/offboarding/background checks (attached)

Hi Lindsey / Acme team — thanks for the patience. Attached is the compiled evidence package and Drive link. Highlights: 

- background_check_policy.pdf: policy describing vendor scope and types of checks performed.
- security-training-completion-logs.csv: LMS export (names redacted where required).
- redwood_offboarding_playbook_v2.pdf & onboarding_checklist.xlsx: playbook and checklist with timestamps.
- SOC2_AICPA_cert.pdf: our current SOC 2 report (summary).

Drive folder (temporary, expires in 7 days): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleDriveLink

We were able to include redacted vendor report samples; the vendor's full reports contain personal identifiers and require a vendor-to-vendor DPA to share directly. If Acme requires the unredacted vendor reports, we can request a signed Data Processing Addendum and escalate to procurement. DocuSign link for the DPA (if needed): https://www.docusign.com/sign/example-session

If you'd like a quick walkthrough of the artifacts, Marcus and I can hop on a 30-minute call tomorrow. Proposed times (PST): 9:30am, 11:00am, 2:00pm. Let me know what works and we'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Attachments: redwood_offboarding_playbook_v2.pdf; background_check_policy.pdf; security-training-completion-logs.csv; onboarding_checklist.xlsx; SOC2_AICPA_cert.pdf
